scope: Validation-only correction. The v218.1 candidate, prediction barrier, formal arrays, scientific gates, tolerances, controls, costs, and decision order remain unchanged.
observed_validator_defects: The first validator used independently recomputed K16 metrics as the matched-accuracy denominator even though the v218.1 contract defines the independently sealed v217.1 K16 metrics as the reference input.

The first validator hard-coded 1e-12 parent-reference metric and field gates instead of consuming the frozen 1e-8 parent-reference metric tolerance; the v218.1 protocol defines no additional parent-reference field tolerance.

correction_rules.independent_replay: Rebuild all 546 cells, all three warm families, and K16 with the independent eigensolve/manual-PCGLS implementation exactly as before.
correction_rules.reference_binding: Require the independently recomputed K16 metrics to match the sealed v217.1 K16 metrics within the unchanged 1e-8 parent-reference metric tolerance and require independently recomputed K16 absolute adequacy.
correction_rules.matched_adjudication: After that independent binding passes, use the sealed v217.1 K16 metrics as the denominator for all matched-accuracy summaries, exactly matching the v218.1 scientific contract and formal adjudication input.
correction_rules.field_audit: Retain the independently recomputed K16 field difference as a diagnostic only; do not create an unregistered field gate.
correction_rules.tolerances: Read every tolerance from the unchanged v218.1 protocol. No threshold may be added, removed, loosened, or selected from the observed scientific values.
correction_rules.decision: The corrected validator must independently reproduce the formal discrete decision exactly or remain inconclusive.
correction_rules.prior_failure: Bind and preserve the first inconclusive validation tree; never overwrite or reinterpret it as a scientific result.
